passages.provision_quote: (42) human trafficking of a minor, in violation of subdivision (c) of Section 236.1, except, with respect to a violation of paragraph (1) of subdivision (c) of Section 236.1, where the person who committed the offense was a victim of human trafficking, as described in subdivision (b) or (c) of Section 236.1, at the time of the offense; and
passages.note: Authored bill adding human trafficking of a minor to the 'serious felony'/Three Strikes definition, showing a tougher-consequences direction for one offense but not a general sentencing philosophy.

rows.reasoning: Grove authored SB 14 (2023-2024), which adds human trafficking of a minor to the Penal Code's 'serious felony' definition, extending Three Strikes eligibility to that offense. This shows direction toward tougher consequences but the instrument addresses one specific offense rather than articulating whether she holds 'accountability is the priority' or 'impose the toughest penalties the law allows' as a general approach to lawbreaking.
